title: ChatGPT for Healthcare connects authorized Epic records and public datasets
friendlyTitle: Healthcare teams can connect patient records to ChatGPT
summary: OpenAI added an Epic integration that lets eligible healthcare organizations bring authorized patient context into ChatGPT for Healthcare. A separate plugin connects nine official public sources, including PubMed, DailyMed, ClinicalTrials.gov and CMS Coverage, while preserving source references for review.
friendlySummary: Approved healthcare organisations can let ChatGPT read authorised information from Epic and search official medical data sources in one workspace.
whyItMatters: Clinicians may spend less time assembling history, medications, results and research before a visit, but summaries remain support for professional judgement rather than a replacement. Access control, audit logs, source checking and local clinical validation are central because errors involve sensitive records and care decisions.
friendlyWhyItMatters: This may save clinicians time when preparing for care. Access must be tightly controlled, and a qualified person must check the result.
